root = Stack([WeightsControl, ScoresTable, RankingsTable, ScoresGraphic])

WeightsControl = Control("Weights (Native Experience, Lightweight Runtime, Delivery Efficiency)",0,100,[40,25,35],$weights)
weights_sum = $weights[0] + $weights[1] + $weights[2]
weights_norm = weights_sum > 0 ? [$weights[0]*100/weights_sum, $weights[1]*100/weights_sum, $weights[2]*100/weights_sum] : [0,0,0]

NativeHybridScores = [9,8,7]
TauriScores = [7,8,8]
ElectronScores = [6,4,10]

NativeHybridWeighted = weights_sum > 0 ? (NativeHybridScores[0]*$weights[0] + NativeHybridScores[1]*$weights[1] + NativeHybridScores[2]*$weights[2]) : 0
TauriWeighted = weights_sum > 0 ? (TauriScores[0]*$weights[0] + TauriScores[1]*$weights[1] + TauriScores[2]*$weights[2]) : 0
ElectronWeighted = weights_sum > 0 ? (ElectronScores[0]*$weights[0] + ElectronScores[1]*$weights[1] + ElectronScores[2]*$weights[2]) : 0

ScoresTable = Table([
  {label:"Native Hybrid", "Native Experience":9, "Lightweight Runtime":8, "Delivery Efficiency":7, "Weighted Score":NativeHybridWeighted},
  {label:"Tauri", "Native Experience":7, "Lightweight Runtime":8, "Delivery Efficiency":8, "Weighted Score":TauriWeighted},
  {label:"Electron", "Native Experience":6, "Lightweight Runtime":4, "Delivery Efficiency":10, "Weighted Score":ElectronWeighted}
])

rankings = weights_sum > 0 ? @Sort([
  {label:"Native Hybrid", score:NativeHybridWeighted},
  {label:"Tauri", score:TauriWeighted},
  {label:"Electron", score:ElectronWeighted}
],"score","desc") : []

RankingsTable = Table(rankings)

bar_width = 120
bar_max_height = 100
bar_spacing = 140
bar_base_y = 120

max_score = @Max([NativeHybridWeighted, TauriWeighted, ElectronWeighted, 1])

NativeHybridBarHeight = max_score > 0 ? (NativeHybridWeighted * bar_max_height / max_score) : 0
TauriBarHeight = max_score > 0 ? (TauriWeighted * bar_max_height / max_score) : 0
ElectronBarHeight = max_score > 0 ? (ElectronWeighted * bar_max_height / max_score) : 0

ScoresGraphic = Graphic("Weighted Scores Bar Chart", [
  text(10,15,"Weights (Normalized): Native Experience "+weights_norm[0].toFixed(1)+"%, Lightweight Runtime "+weights_norm[1].toFixed(1)+"%, Delivery Efficiency "+weights_norm[2].toFixed(1)+"%"),
  text(10,30,"Adjust weights to see impact on rankings."),
  text(20,bar_base_y+15,"Native Hybrid"),
  rect(20,bar_base_y-NativeHybridBarHeight,bar_width,NativeHybridBarHeight),
  text(20,bar_base_y-NativeHybridBarHeight-5,NativeHybridWeighted.toFixed(1)),
  text(20+bar_spacing,bar_base_y+15,"Tauri"),
  rect(20+bar_spacing,bar_base_y-TauriBarHeight,bar_width,TauriBarHeight),
  text(20+
